facts.fact: TechCabal reports on 2024-05-17 that Cameroon-based ST Digital runs a data centre in Cameroon whose clients include local banks, government and big companies; the facility is not named in the article.

note: Tier III is stated for ST Digital's portfolio of four incl. three new builds in GAB, CIV, TGO; the Cameroon site is not identified as Tier III, so no tier3 fact.
